name: help-popover
title: Help popover
description: The small question-mark button beside a label that opens a short explanation with a link or two, for touch, keyboard and screen readers.
docs: label is required: it names the button after what it explains (Help: API rate limit). With side="auto" the popover opens to the right of the field when the label next to the button names one (label for) and there is room, above the label otherwise, and below the field when there is no room above either, so it does not sit on the field. The content can be paragraphs, a list, strong text or a short code sample, which wraps instead of scrolling. A link with external opens in a new tab with noopener and says so to screen readers. It is a non-modal popover: Escape closes it, focus returns to the button, and opening another help button closes the first.
